candidate_identity.candidate_title: Mission View cold-bootstrap must replay every retained event-log generation without silently dropping older projected events
candidate_identity.active_wave_note: C23's open_source entry names a different source path/blob that was not retrievable through the available connector. This audit therefore binds only to the explicit role-local source artifact above and must not be fuzzy-joined to the C23 row.

public_source.freshness_result: The two-file Mission View bootstrap loop is still present on fresh main. No mission-view multi-roll issue/PR or test mentioning events.jsonl.2 was located.

claim_decomposition.bounded_failure_claim: On cold Mission View rebuild, projected events retained only in events.jsonl.2+ can be omitted because _bootstrap_view reads only events.jsonl.1 and events.jsonl.
claim_decomposition.within_selected_file_failure_claim: Even selected generations are truncated to the last 8 MiB before projected-event filtering, so an older projected event in a >8 MiB selected file can also be omitted.
claim_decomposition.impact_scope: Cold bootstrap/recovery observability and event-sourced Mission View fields only. This does not show loss during normal online projection, nor corruption of the canonical retained event log.
claim_decomposition.fix_invariant: A correctness-preserving cold rebuild must not silently omit retained projected events needed to reconstruct the read model.
claim_decomposition.performance_adaptation: Sparse projected-event scanning or a durable checkpoint/cursor is a design suggestion, not reproduced performance evidence.

official_artifact_evidence.event_log_retention: event_log.py states every generation is retained and implements event_log_paths() returning numeric generations >=2, then .1, then live.
official_artifact_evidence.tail_limit: _view_state.py _tail_jsonl() reads at most MISSION_BOOTSTRAP_MAX_BYTES = 8 MiB from the end of each selected file before filtering to projected event types.
official_artifact_evidence.routing_projection: _reduce_manager.py projects route, vertical, workflow_mode, lifetime, continuous and open_ended from life.manager.intent.completed.
official_artifact_evidence.test_surface: Current tests/core/test_mission_view.py exercises cold bootstrap from live events.jsonl and many reducer paths, but repository search found no mission-view test for events.jsonl.2.

independent_reproduction.method: Independent minimal reimplementation of the exact public generation-order, 8 MiB tail, and manager-routing projection logic; official Argus package code was not executed locally because network cloning is unavailable in the runtime.

independent_external_replication.scope: No public issue/PR or protocol-matched third-party reproduction specifically for the Mission View multi-roll bootstrap gap was located in this run.

scope_guards: Do not generalize this to normal online Mission View event loss; online projection is separate and was not shown to fail.
Do not generalize this to canonical event-log loss; retained generations are explicitly preserved.
Do not claim the proposed sparse scan/checkpoint implementation is validated until an actual patch, tests and benchmark exist.
Do not fuzzy-join this audit to the C23 active-wave open_source row; exact source tuple differs.
reopen_conditions: A public patch changes _bootstrap_view to enumerate retained generations or use a durable checkpoint/cursor.
A regression test reproduces .2+ or >8 MiB projected-event survival.
A benchmark quantifies sparse all-generation rebuild cost versus current tail bootstrap.
A production incident or independent third-party reproduction establishes real-world frequency/severity.
exact_next_action: Audit a different source-qualified candidate with materially reducible reproducibility uncertainty. Reopen clean-os-g1-006 only on one of the recorded conditions; if reopened, first inspect the exact patch/test and verify ordering plus >8 MiB survival without weakening canonical event-log retention.
